programme.desc: Si Jin's mother, Bao Ling, returns from overseas and advises Jin Quan to stop objecting to Kai Wei and Si Jin from being together, revealing his selfish motives for doing so. programme.title: My Guardian Angels
programme.desc: Xie Ying is pregnant and looks for Gui Qiang to discuss the matter, both feeling helpless. programme.title: My Guardian Angels
programme.desc: After a few setbacks, Xie Ying and Gui Qiang decide to have the child. Mandy worries that Xie Ying will not be able to adapt to becoming a mother as she is still young.
